purpose: Per-operator cancellation terms and 14 CFR 295.24 disclosure data, consumed by sign.valleyjet.com at contract-generation time. The CANCELLATION POLICY section of the client contract is replaced with the selected operator's section_text so the signed document always matches the carrier actually flying the trip. Operators without verified tiers are hard-blocked in the admin UI.
tier_evaluation: bands are checked smallest within_hours first; the first band whose within_hours >= hours-until-departure wins. If no band matches, baseline_pct applies. Percentages already include the standing +10% ValleyJet markup.

cancellation.section_text: CANCELLATION POLICY: ValleyJet LLC will work in good faith with the Client to reschedule or restructure trips when operationally feasible and when the operating Part 135 certificate holder permits; however, the following cancellation tiers apply when changes cannot be accommodated. Cancellations made more than five (5) days prior to the scheduled flight departure time will incur a 10% cancellation fee, with the remaining 90% applied as a credit toward a future flight booked through ValleyJet LLC. Cancellations made less than three (3) days prior to the scheduled flight departure time will incur a 90% cancellation fee, with the remaining 10% applied as a credit toward a future flight booked through ValleyJet LLC. Cancellations made within 48 hours of the scheduled flight departure time are 100% non-refundable and no credit will be issued. Trips scheduled during peak travel periods are subject to a 100% cancellation charge. In cases of no-shows, a cancellation fee equal to 100% of the full contract amount, along with any related expenses incurred, will be applied. Any fees incurred by ValleyJet LLC to reserve the execution of the trip, such as PPRs, Special Event fees, etc., will not be refunded. All trip dates are based off the signed contract's original date and time. Should a flight be canceled before cash funds are received, ValleyJet LLC will utilize the credit card hold as payment for the cancellation fee. A 6% payment processing fee will be added to such transactions. No refunds will be given on credit card processing fees. ValleyJet LLC reserves the right to adjust arrival and departure times and locations when necessary to ensure the safety of passengers and crew. Alterations to the trip may occur due to factors such as weather conditions, crew rest requirements, NOTAMs, TFRs, Ground Stops, ATC delays, etc. These changes do not permit cancellations with a refund. Flights flown by a ValleyJet LLC vetted and approved FAA Part 135 Operator may be subject to a different cancellation policy. Cancellation fees may be applied as credit toward a future trip booked within twelve (12) months of the original departure date, at ValleyJet LLC's sole discretion and subject to operator approval; any such credit is restricted to future flights operated on the same aircraft (identified by tail number) as the originally contracted trip and may not be redeemed against flights on a different aircraft regardless of operator, type, or category. Where the operating FAA Part 135 carrier imposes a cancellation policy more restrictive than the tiers stated above, that carrier's policy governs and is passed through to Client in full. ValleyJet LLC will disclose any such carrier-imposed policy to Client in writing at the time of booking.

additional_clauses.heading: VALIDITY
additional_clauses.text: For this itinerary, the operating carrier's pricing is held for twelve (12) hours from the time the carrier issued its quote, and ValleyJet LLC's quoted price is subject to re-confirmation with the operating carrier if this Agreement is not executed within that window.
additional_clauses.source: Jet Excellence quote GMIKU8-01 (2026-09-11), Section 2 PRICES, PAYMENTS

additional_clauses.heading: SCHEDULE CHANGES AND ITINERARY CHANGES
additional_clauses.text: For this itinerary, each booked trip includes up to two (2) Client-requested itinerary changes at no administrative charge; beginning with the third (3rd) change, each additional change is subject to a $500 administrative change fee, in addition to any increase in the cost of the trip resulting from the requested change. Each material modification to the booked itinerary constitutes a separate change, including changes submitted together in a single request. Changes initiated by the operating carrier for operational requirements, or to correct the carrier's own error, do not count toward the two-change allowance.
additional_clauses.source: Jet Excellence quote GMIKU8-01 (2026-09-11), Section 4 ITINERARY CHANGES AND TRANSMITTAL OF CHANGES

cancellation.section_text: CANCELLATION POLICY: ValleyJet LLC will work in good faith with the Client to reschedule or restructure trips when operationally feasible and when the operating Part 135 certificate holder permits; however, the following cancellation tiers apply when changes cannot be accommodated. Cancellation timing is measured against the earlier of the departure date and time stated in this Agreement or any subsequently authorized adjusted departure date and time. For domestic flights (itineraries operated entirely within the contiguous United States) that are priced as round-trip or multi-city itineraries and that do not occur during peak/holiday travel periods, cancellations made more than seventy-two (72) hours before the scheduled departure time will incur a 10% cancellation fee; cancellations made within seventy-two (72) hours but more than forty-eight (48) hours before the scheduled departure time will incur a 35% cancellation fee; cancellations made within forty-eight (48) hours but more than twenty-four (24) hours before the scheduled departure time will incur a 60% cancellation fee; and cancellations made within twenty-four (24) hours of the scheduled departure time are 100% non-refundable; in each case together with any flight planning expenses already incurred. Itineraries priced as one-way (that is, priced at less than round-trip pricing) and empty-leg itineraries are 100% non-refundable from the time this Agreement is signed, and Client acknowledges that this applies whether or not the scheduled departure date is months in the future. One-way priced itineraries also require schedule flexibility for the entire day booked and are subject to the schedule and availability of the underlying charter flight, including changes to departure times or dates; if the underlying charter flight is changed or cancelled, the one-way priced flight may also be changed or cancelled, in which case ValleyJet LLC will offer a full-price charter alternative where one is available. For international flights (any itinerary that includes at least one airport outside of the contiguous United States, including itineraries serving Alaska and Hawaii), a non-refundable fee of $5,000 plus 10% of the contract amount applies from the time this Agreement is signed; cancellations made within seven (7) days but more than seventy-two (72) hours before the scheduled departure time will incur a 35% cancellation fee; cancellations made within seventy-two (72) hours but more than forty-eight (48) hours before the scheduled departure time will incur a 60% cancellation fee; and cancellations made within forty-eight (48) hours of the scheduled departure time are 100% non-refundable; in each case together with all costs and fees related to international flight planning, permits, and handling, which are non-refundable in full. For any itinerary that encompasses peak/holiday travel dates, cancellations made within seven (7) days of the scheduled departure time are 100% non-refundable, and cancellations made more than seven (7) days before the scheduled departure time are subject to the tiers stated above for the applicable itinerary type. Any fees incurred upon booking, such as airport slot fees, PPRs, or special event fees, are 100% non-refundable if Client changes or cancels the trip in which those fees were incurred. In cases of no-shows, a cancellation fee equal to 100% of the full contract amount, along with any related expenses incurred, will be applied. Any fees incurred by ValleyJet LLC to reserve the execution of the trip, such as PPRs, Special Event fees, etc., will not be refunded. All trip dates are based off the signed contract's original date and time. Should a flight be canceled before cash funds are received, ValleyJet LLC will utilize the credit card hold as payment for the cancellation fee. A 4% payment processing fee will be added to such transactions. No refunds will be given on credit card processing fees. ValleyJet LLC reserves the right to adjust arrival and departure times and locations when necessary to ensure the safety of passengers and crew. Alterations to the trip may occur due to factors such as weather conditions, crew rest requirements, NOTAMs, TFRs, Ground Stops, ATC delays, etc. These changes do not permit cancellations with a refund. Where the operating FAA Part 135 carrier imposes a cancellation policy more restrictive than the tiers stated above, that carrier's policy governs and is passed through to Client in full; this includes, without limitation, one-way, point-to-point, and empty-leg itineraries, which certain carriers treat as 100% non-refundable from the time of booking. ValleyJet LLC will disclose any such carrier-imposed policy to Client in writing at the time of booking. Cancellation fees may be applied as credit toward a future trip booked within twelve (12) months of the original departure date, at ValleyJet LLC's sole discretion and subject to operator approval.

additional_clauses.heading: ADDITIONAL FEES AND EXPENSES
additional_clauses.text: For this itinerary, selection of an FBO other than the operating carrier's preferred FBO at any airport is assessed at $1,500 per change, in addition to any facility fees charged by that FBO. Special event fees imposed by an FBO or airport for high-traffic events (sporting events, trade shows, performances, and similar) are the responsibility of Client in full even where not included in the quoted price, as is any crew lodging booked in connection with such an event. Additional flight time incurred due to weather delays, ATC holds, or other situations outside the operating carrier's control, together with catering, ground transportation, flight phone, data or internet use, de-icing, and hangar charges, is invoiced after flight completion, and the fuel surcharge remains subject to market conditions at the time of the flight.
